name: Blossom
description: After a troubled childhood, Dou Zhao retreats to a village, where she meets Song Mo, a merchant with a hidden past. To navigate family schemes and personal challenges, they form an alliance, growing from reluctant partners to trusted allies as they strive to protect what matters most.

videos.title: Fortune Lies Within Misfortune
videos.overview: In the winter of the 27th year of Emperor Cheng Ping's reign, General Song Mo of the Cavalry launched a night raid on the capital. Meanwhile, Dou Zhao discovers the Marquis of Ji Ning's secret.

videos.title: Nine-Layered Purple
videos.overview: Knowing the future events, Dou Zhao seizes the opportunity to secure her future amongst the shifts within her family.

videos.title: Family Reunion
videos.overview: Dou Zhao returns to her family manor for a matchmaking event, masked as a reunion.

videos.title: Stalking
videos.overview: Dou Zhao and Song Mo unknowingly attend the same performance at the theater. Back at Cui Manor, Dou Zhao learns medicinal skills from Yuantong and as a natural disaster unfolds, both Dou Zhao and Song Mo do their best to aid the people.

videos.title: Situation Reversed
videos.overview: Jiang Meisun is urgently summoned back to the capital by the emperor. Meanwhile, Song Mo seeks refuge at Cui Manor.

videos.title: Dragon Boat Festival banquet
videos.overview: Dou Shishu, aiming to gain more power in court, persuades Wang Yingxue to arrange a meeting with Wu Shan, Wei Tingyu, and the Dou ladies.

videos.title: Break Off the Engagement
videos.overview: Song Mo angers Dai Jian and Dou Shishu by helping Dou Zhao and Dou Zhao assert her opinions on marriage.

videos.title: Imprisoned
videos.overview: The Emperor orders an investigation into the Duke of Jing's case. Meanwhile, Dou Zhao works from the outside to help Song Mo.

videos.title: Broken Trust
videos.overview: Wu Shan argues with his grandfather over his proposal to marry Dou Zhao. While Dou Zhao loses Song Mo's trust and leaves for Fu Ting to uncover the truth.

videos.title: Work Together
videos.overview: Dou Zhao and Song Mo board the ship, seeking clues to the case, and find that there is more to the case than meets the eye.

videos.title: Put aside
videos.overview: Song Mo disbands the Ding Army and Dou Zhao helps the Miao family during their crisis in Fu Ting.

videos.title: Different
videos.overview: Song Mo leaves for Liaodong and is called home to visit his sick mother and Dou Zhao returns to the capital to be under house arrest.

videos.title: A Helpless Move
videos.overview: Song Mo takes over to perform the rites for his mother's funeral while Dou Zhao is accused of bringing dishonor to the family.

videos.title: Destiny
videos.overview: Dou Zhao participates in the Ladies' Etiquette Contest while Song Mo participates in the harvest hunting contest.

videos.title: Go astray
videos.overview: Discussions about Dou Zhao and Wei Tingyu's marriage are progressing, leaving Song Mo and Dou Ming feeling uneasy.

videos.title: Complete
videos.overview: The marriage proceeds as planned and Dou Ming finally stands up to Wang Yingxue.

videos.title: Bride Swap
videos.overview: Dou Shiying stands up for Dou Zhao and Song Mo confesses his feelings.

videos.title: Marriage Confirmed
videos.overview: After all these events, Dou Zhao and Song Mo finally understood their hearts belong to each other.

videos.title: Union
videos.overview: The wedding of Song Mo and Dou Zhao was held smoothly and everyone came to celebrate.

videos.title: Quietly Endure
videos.overview: Wei Tingzhen was jealous when she heard that Dou Zhao's bankruptcy was fake and that he was even richer than before.

videos.title: Causing Trouble
videos.overview: Dou Zhao and Song Mo were in love after their marriage. Song Yi chun sent Lu Zheng to find out more.

videos.title: Colluding with the Cangbei
videos.overview: Wei Tingyu felt guilty about Dou Ming's miscarriage...

videos.title: Bandits in the Capital
videos.overview: Dou Zhao felt something was wrong. Bandits surrounded the residence and all the escape routes were blocked. Dou Zhao tried to escape...

videos.title: Eradicate the Bandits
videos.overview: Shi Shu saw that Song Mo had the ability to defeat the bandits. He recommended Song Mo to lead the troops into battle.

videos.title: Confrontation
videos.overview: Song Mo ordered to surround Song Yichun's residence and confront his father directly.

videos.title: Something Amiss
videos.overview: Song Mo transferred all his property under Dou Zhao's name. Dou Zhao felt something amiss.

videos.title: Building Faction
videos.overview: Dou Zhao and Song Mo Ran analyzed the situation. Now, whoever wants to win, the Crown Prince or the Prince Qing's camp, can't bypass Song Mo...

videos.title: Bestowed Marriage
videos.overview: Song Han was chosen as the top scorer of the martial arts examination, the emperor appointed him the post of Tengxiang Guard.

videos.title: Parted Ways
videos.overview: Dou Zhao is pregnant. Song Mo and Dou Zhao are very happy for this good news.

videos.title: Solving Doubts
videos.overview: Prince Qing traveled together with the Crown Prince, and Song Mo accompanied them. Prince Qing and Song Mo fought fiercely.

videos.title: The Contract
videos.overview: Dou Zhao met with Wei Tingzhen for negotiations, hoping that his father could get away with it.

videos.title: Dependent on Each Other
videos.overview: Song Han took advantage of Song Mo's imprisonment and Dou Zhao's coma to attack.

videos.title: Rebellion
videos.overview: The emperor has not recovered from his illness for a long time, and a rebellion on him is imminent.

videos.title: Between Life and Death
videos.overview: Prince Qing was determined to take the throne. Song Han greeted Prince Qing at the Gate personally...
